title: You are amazing God
lyrics_original: From the highest of heights to the depths of the sea
From the colors of fall to the fragrance of spring
Every creature unique in the song that it sings
You placed the stars in the sky and You know them by name.
Awestruck we fall to our knees as we humbly proclaim
Who has told every lightning bolt where it should go
Or seen heavenly storehouses laden with snow
Who imagined the sun and gives source to its light
Yet conceals it to bring us the coolness of night

bible_verses.telugu: ఆకాశములు దేవుని మహిమను వివరించుచున్నవి అంతరిక్షము ఆయన చేతిపనిని ప్రచురపరచుచున్నది.
bible_verses.english: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.

bible_verses.telugu: నక్షత్రముల సంఖ్యను ఆయన నియమించియున్నాడు వాటికన్నిటికి పేరులు పెట్టుచున్నాడు.
bible_verses.english: He determines the number of the stars and calls them each by name.

bible_verses.telugu: ఆలోచించుము, దేవుడు మహోన్నతుడు మనము ఆయనను ఎరుగము ఆయన సంవత్సరముల సంఖ్య మితిలేనిది.
bible_verses.english: How great is God—beyond our understanding! The number of his years is past finding out.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God, my heart is filled with awe when I consider the wonder of Your creation and the beauty of Your holiness. You hold the stars in Your hands, yet You invite me to draw near to You each day. Help me to live with a posture of humility, recognizing Your grandeur in every detail of my life. I bow before You today, thanking You for Your infinite love and power. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Look around at the vast expanse of creation, from the soaring heights of the mountains to the quiet beauty of changing seasons. The same God who stretched out the heavens and named every star holds your life with intimate care and infinite grace. When we glimpse His unmatched power and majesty, our hearts naturally respond in wonder and humble adoration. Let this song draw you into a moment of worship, resting in the presence of a God who is both wondrously vast and lovingly close to you.
